lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white circular clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern posterior to the gills, forming roughly five parallel horizontal rows across the lateral surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a mesh-like coordinate system on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient, with high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) positioned dorsally, anteriorly, and ventrally relative to the pectoral fin.
